title: Nugatory
summary: NU'GATORY, adjective 1. Trifling; vain; futile; insignificant. 2. Of no force; inoperative; ineffectual. The laws are sometimes rendered nugatory by inexecution. Any agreement may be rendered nugatory

inlines.v: NU'GATORY, adjective 1. Trifling; vain; futile; insignificant. 2. Of no force; inoperative; ineffectual. The laws are sometimes rendered nugatory by inexecution. Any agreement may be rendered nugatory by something which contravenes its execution.
